facts.text: dronesim is a pyBullet and gym-pybullet-drones based heterogeneous multi vehicle control and simulation framework
BaseAviary subclasses gym.Env
CtrlAviary subclasses BaseAviary
CtrlAviary's action space is a Dict with one Box per drone, its low from that drone's MIN_PWM and its high from MAX_PWM
The default tello drone has four actuators (actuator_nr=4)
The tello URDF's PWM limit is 0 to 1 per actuator
CtrlAviary declares a per-drone observation Dict {state: Box(16), neighbors: MultiBinary(NUM_DRONES)}
The observation state vector stacks position (3), quaternion (4), roll-pitch-yaw (3), velocity (3), angular velocity (3) and the last motor command (4 for tello); its docstring declares it (20,)
BaseAviary.reset() takes no seed or options argument
BaseAviary.step returns the four-value tuple obs, reward, done, info
BaseAviary.step advances the PyBullet simulation with p.stepSimulation for each aggregate physics step
CtrlAviary's default physics frequency is 240 Hz
BaseAviary sets TIMESTEP = 1.0 / SIM_FREQ
BaseAviary uses gravity 9.8 m/s^2
CtrlAviary returns reward -1 on every step
CtrlAviary returns done False on every step: it declares no terminal state
CtrlAviary returns info {'answer': 42} on every step
When initial_xyzs is None, drone i starts at (i*4*L, i*4*L, COLLISION_H/2 - COLLISION_Z_OFFSET + 0.1)
The adjacency matrix starts as the identity and marks a pair of drones as neighbours when their distance is below NEIGHBOURHOOD_RADIUS
setup.py installs only the top-level dronesim package and requires numpy, scipy, Pillow, matplotlib, cycler, gym and pybullet

determinism.notes: BaseAviary.reset() takes no seed (dronesim/envs/BaseAviary.py:406) and the upstream model uses no RNG, so a reset rebuilds the same initial state; the fake is deterministic too and accepts the seed for the family's cap.world.seed.v1 bookkeeping.  Every seed therefore repeats the same trajectory on this fake; the seed is recorded but not consumed.

gaps: the fake backend is a kinematic stand-in, not the upstream F1 PyBullet model: no contacts, mass and inertia dynamics, aerodynamics, ground effect, downwash, drag, actuator, sensor or noise model; the PWM command moves the published state by fixed per-tick increments

the fake models one four-motor tello drone (CtrlAviary's default drone_model ['tello'], num_drones 1); multi-drone adjacency, other drone models and initial_xyzs, initial_vels and initial_rpys are not modelled

the fake publishes the single tello's four PWM commands as one Box(4) instead of upstream's Dict keyed by the numeric drone index ('0'); the bridge's limit-path grammar cannot name a key that starts with a digit (action.0), and for one drone the four commands are the same; the fake's step also accepts the upstream Dict form
CtrlAviary declares a 16-element state Box but _getDroneStateVector returns 16 values plus the last motor command (20 for tello); the fake publishes a 20-element Box and returns the 20-value state
the upstream reset() takes no seed or options and the fake uses no RNG; cap.world.seed.v1 is served by the family but does not change the trajectory
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment (pybullet and gym are not importable where the gate runs) and the model was never validated against a physical drone

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
